conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support. This is Telecom Haiku.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi there, James from tech support. What can I help you with today?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, so I'm trying to log into my online account to check my bill, but it keeps saying my password is wrong. I know I'm entering it correctly.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Ah, that happens sometimes. Let me reset your password for you. Check your email in a few minutes.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That's great, thanks. Um, do I need to do anything on my end or will it just work?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: You'll get an email with a reset link. Click it, create a new password, and you're all set.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Welcome to Telecom Haiku sales. One moment please.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi! Rachel here. Are you interested in switching your internet service?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, I've been thinking about it. My current speeds are pretty slow and my bill's gone up three times in the last year. I'm frustrated with my provider.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I totally understand. We can get you much faster speeds with a better price. How many people use your internet at home?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's just me and my spouse, so we don't need anything too crazy. We mostly stream shows and browse.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect. Our standard plan would work great for you. 300 Mbps for 59 dollars a month. Want to get started today?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department. Please have your account number handy.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Marcus here. What brings you in?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Marcus. My credit card is expiring next month and I need to update it on my account before the next bill hits.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Easy fix. I can update that right now. What's your new card number?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh, um, let me just... okay. It's 4532... I'd rather not say this all over the phone. Can I do this online?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Nicole here. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Nicole. I set up my email on my phone using your email service, but it's not pulling in my old messages. It's only showing new ones from today.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's usually a sync issue. Let me walk you through clearing the cache and re-adding the account.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, yeah, I'll do that. Where do I find the cache settings? I'm not super tech savvy.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Go into Settings, then Mail, scroll down and you'll see an option to remove the account. Remove it, restart your phone, and add it back. That should sync all your messages.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Kevin speaking. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Kevin. I'm looking to downgrade my service. I got a new job that requires me to travel a lot, so I won't be home as much.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. What service would you like to downgrade?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I want to reduce my data plan to the basic tier.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer retention department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Tanya from retention here. I understand you may be thinking about leaving us?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, honestly I've been a loyal customer for five years but my bill just keeps going up. I got an offer from a competitor and they're 20 dollars cheaper for the same service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I really value your business. Let me check what loyalty discounts I can offer you to bring that cost down.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I appreciate that. How much can you do? Because if it's not significant, I think I need to make the switch.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku customer service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Victor here. What can I help you with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Victor. I'm thinking about switching to Haiku but I wanted to check if you service my area first before I make any commitments.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Of course! What's your zip code and I'll check our coverage map for you.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support for mobile services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Maria here. What's going on with your phone?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: So like, every time I try to use data, I get this error message. The WiFi works fine but the cellular data just won't work. I checked and I have data in my plan.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Data errors can be tricky. First thing, go to your settings and turn airplane mode on for ten seconds, then off.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, doing that... oh! Oh wow, it's working now! That was quick. Thank you so much.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Awesome! That usually forces a reconnection to the network. Let me know if you have any other issues.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department. Thank you for your patience.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Brandon from sales. Interested in learning about our TV packages?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Um, maybe. I already have streaming services, so I'm not sure if cable TV is worth it anymore. What channels do you offer?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We have over 200 channels including all the major ones. Sports, news, entertainment, family programming. Plus you can record shows.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That's... okay but like, how much is it? I really don't want to spend more than I already am.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Alan from billing. What can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, I'm calling because I was charged an international roaming fee but I didn't travel anywhere. I've been home the whole month!

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me investigate that. International roaming fees are unusual if you haven't left the country.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Can you just remove the charge? It's 45 dollars and I'm not paying for something I didn't do.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Gregory here. What's happening?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Gregory. My router died. It just stopped working completely. One second it was fine, the next nothing. No lights, no nothing.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sounds like a hardware failure. We can send you a replacement router at no charge. Should arrive in 3-5 business days.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Really? That's helpful. What about internet in the meantime? I really need it for work.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I can priority ship it so you get it tomorrow. And if you need a loaner device, we can arrange that too.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Sophia here. How can I assist?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Sophia. I need to update my phone number on my account. I just got a new number.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: No problem. I can do that for you right now. What's your new number?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Welcome to Telecom Haiku sales.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hey there, Derek speaking. Can I tell you about our bundle offers?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Actually yeah, I'm interested. I'm paying way too much for separate services. Internet, phone, TV from three different companies. It's ridiculous.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's exactly what our bundle solves. You can combine all three services and save around 40 percent.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: 40 percent? That's huge! How much would the total be for everything?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: 89 dollars a month for everything. Internet, unlimited mobile, and TV.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Amber here. What do you need help with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Amber. I'm going on vacation for two weeks and I want to forward my calls to my cell phone so I don't miss anything important.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Easy. I can set that up for you. What's your cell number?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 555-0289. And um, I'll be back on the 15th, so I'll need to turn it off then unless I ask.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Retention services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Paula here. I see you've been with us for a long time. Is there something I can do to keep you?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Well, yeah, I've been thinking about switching. A competitor sent me an offer and it's tempting. But I do like your service overall.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I appreciate your loyalty. Let me see what exclusive offers I can put together for you as a long-term customer.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That would be nice. I'd rather stay with you if the pricing is competitive. What do you have?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Douglas here. What's the question?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Douglas. I got my bill and there's a line item called 'regulatory fee'. What exactly is that for?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's a government-mandated fee. It goes to fund regulatory programs in your state.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh, so that's not something you guys are adding on? It's required?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Travis from support. What's the issue today?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, so I'm trying to watch movies on my TV and the video keeps buffering. Like every few minutes it pauses while it loads. My internet's supposed to be fast.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Buffering is usually either a bandwidth issue or the TV app needs updating. Have you updated the app recently?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Um, I'm not sure. I think it was updated automatically but let me check... yeah it says current version.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me send a test signal to check your connection speed. Give it a second... okay your speed looks fine. Let's try clearing the app cache and see if that helps.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department. Please hold.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi, Crystal from sales here. What brings you in?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Crystal. I'm considering switching my mobile service to Haiku. I want to know about your coverage in my area and your plans.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Great! I can help with that. What's your zip code and what's most important to you - data, price, or coverage?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: 90210. I mainly want good coverage and reasonable pricing. What are your cheapest options?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Leonard here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Leonard. I saw a promotion for free installation. Does that apply to me if I'm switching from another carrier?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, absolutely. Free installation for all new customers.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Valerie from tech support. What's the problem?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Valerie. You guys sent me a new modem but I don't know how to hook it all up. There's cables everywhere and I'm confused.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Don't worry, it's simpler than it looks. The main cable from the wall goes into the port labeled 'IN' on the back.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, I see the IN port. What about all these other cables?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Those are ethernet cables for connecting devices. Just plug in the power and you're good to go.
